definition: used to say what is really true, often when it is different from what people expect
example: I thought the call was at noon, but it is actually at ten.
exampleEs: Pensé que la llamada era al mediodía, pero en realidad es a las diez.
cloze: I thought the call was at noon, but it is ____ at ten.
note: Trap: 'actualmente' means currently; actually means 'en realidad'.

definition: after a long time or a lot of steps
example: The build failed twice, but it eventually passed.
exampleEs: La compilación falló dos veces, pero al final pasó.
cloze: The build failed twice, but it ____ passed.
note: Trap: 'eventualmente' means occasionally or possibly; eventually means 'al final'.

definition: to help someone do something
example: Two engineers will assist the new hire during her first week.
exampleEs: Dos ingenieros ayudarán a la nueva empleada durante su primera semana.
cloze: Two engineers will ____ the new hire during her first week.
note: Trap: 'asistir a' is attend; assist means 'ayudar'.

definition: to be present at an event, class or meeting
example: Everyone on the team must attend the demo on Friday.
exampleEs: Todos en el equipo deben asistir a la demostración del viernes.
cloze: Everyone on the team must ____ the demo on Friday.
note: Trap: 'asistir' is attend, not assist. No 'to' after attend: attend the meeting.

definition: to suddenly understand or notice something
example: I only realized my mistake after the release went live.
exampleEs: Solo me di cuenta de mi error después de que salió la versión.
cloze: I only ____ my mistake after the release went live.
note: Trap: 'realizar' means do or carry out; realize means 'darse cuenta'.

definition: showing good judgment and practical thinking
example: Using a password manager is a sensible choice.
exampleEs: Usar un gestor de contraseñas es una decisión sensata.
cloze: Using a password manager is a ____ choice.
note: Trap: Spanish 'sensible' is sensitive in English; English sensible means 'sensato'.

definition: feeling shy, awkward or ashamed in front of other people
example: I felt embarrassed when my microphone was still on.
exampleEs: Me dio vergüenza cuando mi micrófono seguía encendido.
cloze: I felt ____ when my microphone was still on.
note: Trap: 'embarazada' means pregnant. Say 'I'm embarrassed' for 'me da pena'.

definition: a place where you can read or borrow books
example: I study at the university library because it is quiet.
exampleEs: Estudio en la biblioteca de la universidad porque es tranquila.
cloze: I study at the university ____ because it is quiet.
note: Trap: 'librería' is a bookstore; library means 'biblioteca'.

definition: the work you do over many years of your life
example: She built a successful career in data science.
exampleEs: Construyó una carrera exitosa en ciencia de datos.
cloze: She built a successful ____ in data science.
note: Trap: a university 'carrera' is a degree or major; career is your working life.

definition: thick soft material that covers a floor
example: The new carpet in the office is dark blue.
exampleEs: La alfombra nueva de la oficina es azul oscuro.
cloze: The new ____ in the office is dark blue.
note: Trap: 'carpeta' is a folder; carpet means 'alfombra'.

definition: the way out of a building or place
example: Use the emergency exit if the alarm goes off.
exampleEs: Usa la salida de emergencia si suena la alarma.
cloze: Use the emergency ____ if the alarm goes off.
note: Trap: 'éxito' means success; exit means 'salida'.

definition: the act of making someone believe something that is not true
example: The company's deception only came to light after the audit.
exampleEs: El engaño de la empresa solo salió a la luz después de la auditoría.
cloze: The company's ____ only came to light after the audit.
note: Trap: 'decepción' means disappointment; deception means 'engaño'.

definition: unable to empty your bowels easily
example: He felt constipated after a week of eating almost no fiber.
exampleEs: Se sintió estreñido después de una semana comiendo casi nada de fibra.
cloze: He felt ____ after a week of eating almost no fiber.
note: Trap: 'constipado' means having a cold. In English, constipated is only about the bowels.

definition: a long talk given to students or an audience about a subject
example: The professor's lecture on neural networks lasted an hour.
exampleEs: La clase del profesor sobre redes neuronales duró una hora.
cloze: The professor's ____ on neural networks lasted an hour.
note: Trap: 'lectura' means reading; lecture means a talk by a speaker.

definition: an angry conversation where people disagree
example: We had a long argument about which framework to use.
exampleEs: Tuvimos una larga discusión sobre qué framework usar.
cloze: We had a long ____ about which framework to use.
note: Trap: argument usually means a fight, not just 'argumento'. For a point in a debate, say 'point' or 'reasoning'.

definition: to take something away from a place
example: Please remove the old files from the shared folder.
exampleEs: Por favor, elimina los archivos viejos de la carpeta compartida.
cloze: Please ____ the old files from the shared folder.
note: Trap: 'remover' means to stir; remove means 'quitar'.

definition: to agree with a plan or help it succeed
example: Our manager will support the proposal at the board meeting.
exampleEs: Nuestro gerente respaldará la propuesta en la reunión de la junta.
cloze: Our manager will ____ the proposal at the board meeting.
note: Trap: 'soportar' means to tolerate; for that, use stand or put up with.

definition: to watch something carefully over time
example: We use dashboards to monitor server errors in real time.
exampleEs: Usamos paneles para monitorear los errores del servidor en tiempo real.
cloze: We use dashboards to ____ server errors in real time.
note: Trap: Spanish 'monitorizar' is just 'monitor' in English. 'Monitorize' does not exist.

definition: to create or produce something
example: Let's make a plan before we start the sprint.
exampleEs: Hagamos un plan antes de empezar el sprint.
cloze: Let's ____ a plan before we start the sprint.
note: Trap: Spanish 'hacer' covers both. Make is for creating results (a plan, a mistake, a decision).

definition: to carry out an activity or task
example: I still need to do the dishes before the call starts.
exampleEs: Todavía tengo que lavar los platos antes de que empiece la llamada.
cloze: I still need to ____ the dishes before the call starts.
note: Trap: Spanish 'hacer' covers both. Do is for tasks and activities; don't say 'do a mistake' or 'do a decision'.

definition: real, as opposed to what people think or say
example: What was the actual cause of the outage?
exampleEs: ¿Cuál fue la causa real de la caída?
cloze: What was the ____ cause of the outage?
note: Trap: 'actual' in Spanish means current; English actual means 'real'. For current, use current or present.

definition: easily hurt or affected, or needing careful handling
example: Be careful with sensitive customer data.
exampleEs: Ten cuidado con los datos delicados de los clientes.
cloze: Be careful with ____ customer data.
note: Trap: Spanish 'sensible' is sensitive in English; English sensible means 'sensato'.

definition: cloth made by weaving threads
example: The jacket is made of a soft, waterproof fabric.
exampleEs: La chamarra está hecha de una tela suave e impermeable.
cloze: The jacket is made of a soft, waterproof ____.
note: Trap: 'fábrica' means factory; fabric means 'tela'.

definition: big in size or amount
example: They ordered a large pizza for the whole team.
exampleEs: Pidieron una pizza grande para todo el equipo.
cloze: They ordered a ____ pizza for the whole team.
note: Trap: 'largo' means long; large means 'grande'.

definition: the result of achieving what you wanted
example: The launch was a huge success, with 10,000 sign-ups.
exampleEs: El lanzamiento fue un gran éxito, con 10,000 registros.
cloze: The launch was a huge ____, with 10,000 sign-ups.
note: Trap: 'suceso' means event; success means 'éxito'.

definition: to start again after a pause
example: We will resume the meeting after a short break.
exampleEs: Retomaremos la reunión después de un breve descanso.
cloze: We will ____ the meeting after a short break.
note: Trap: 'resumir' means summarize; resume means 'reanudar'. In US English, the noun résumé is a CV.

definition: having had a good education
example: He is highly educated and has a master's degree.
exampleEs: Tiene un alto nivel de estudios y una maestría.
cloze: He is highly ____ and has a master's degree.
note: Trap: 'educado' means polite; for that, use polite or well-mannered.

definition: your mother and father
example: My parents live in Guadalajara; my aunts and cousins live nearby.
exampleEs: Mis padres viven en Guadalajara; mis tías y primos viven cerca.
cloze: My ____ live in Guadalajara; my aunts and cousins live nearby.
note: Trap: 'parientes' means relatives; parents are only your mother and father.

definition: to save sound or video so it can be played later
example: Please record the meeting so Ana can watch it later.
exampleEs: Por favor, graba la reunión para que Ana la vea después.
cloze: Please ____ the meeting so Ana can watch it later.
note: Trap: 'recordar' means remember; record means 'grabar'.

definition: to deliberately pay no attention to something
example: Don't ignore the warning messages in the log.
exampleEs: No ignores los mensajes de advertencia en el registro.
cloze: Don't ____ the warning messages in the log.
note: Trap: Spanish 'ignorar' can mean 'not know'. English ignore is on purpose; say 'I don't know the answer', not 'I ignore the answer'.

definition: chemicals added to food to keep it fresh longer
example: The jam has no artificial preservatives.
exampleEs: La mermelada no tiene conservantes artificiales.
cloze: The jam has no artificial ____.
note: Trap: 'preservativo' means condom; preservative means 'conservante'.

definition: to ask for something in a strong way
example: Customers demand fast, reliable support.
exampleEs: Los clientes exigen soporte rápido y confiable.
cloze: Customers ____ fast, reliable support.
note: Trap: 'demandar' means to sue; for that, use sue or file a lawsuit.

definition: to behave as if something is true when it is not
example: Don't pretend you understood the question if you didn't.
exampleEs: No finjas que entendiste la pregunta si no la entendiste.
cloze: Don't ____ you understood the question if you didn't.
note: Trap: 'pretender' means to intend or want; for that, use intend or plan.

definition: showing that you understand and care about someone's problems
example: My manager was sympathetic when I explained the delay.
exampleEs: Mi jefe fue comprensivo cuando le expliqué el retraso.
cloze: My manager was ____ when I explained the delay.
note: Trap: 'simpático' means nice or friendly; for that, use nice or likable.

definition: to tell people each other's names when they meet for the first time
example: Let me introduce you to our new designer, Sofia.
exampleEs: Déjame presentarte a nuestra nueva diseñadora, Sofía.
cloze: Let me ____ you to our new designer, Sofia.
note: Trap: 'introducir' means insert; introduce is for people and new ideas.

definition: an agreement where each side gives up something
example: After a long talk, we reached a compromise.
exampleEs: Después de una larga charla, llegamos a un acuerdo de punto medio.
cloze: After a long talk, we reached a ____.
note: Trap: 'compromiso' often means commitment or obligation; for those, use commitment.

definition: happy and full of energy about something that will happen
example: I'm really excited about the new release next week.
exampleEs: Estoy muy emocionado por la nueva versión de la próxima semana.
cloze: I'm really ____ about the new release next week.
note: Trap: 'excitado' sounds sexual in Spanish; excited is fully normal at work.

definition: a thick, strong cord made of twisted threads
example: We tied the tent down with a strong rope.
exampleEs: Aseguramos la tienda con una cuerda resistente.
cloze: We tied the tent down with a strong ____.
note: Trap: 'ropa' means clothes; rope means 'cuerda'.

definition: to officially say that something is wrong and challenge it
example: Our lawyers plan to contest the fine.
exampleEs: Nuestros abogados planean impugnar la multa.
cloze: Our lawyers plan to ____ the fine.
note: Trap: 'contestar' means answer; contest means to challenge. For answering, use answer or reply.

definition: a large place with seats where concerts or sports happen
example: The band played in a huge arena with 20,000 seats.
exampleEs: La banda tocó en un enorme recinto con 20,000 asientos.
cloze: The band played in a huge ____ with 20,000 seats.
note: Trap: Spanish 'arena' means sand; English arena is a large venue. Sand is 'sand'.

definition: extremely beautiful and made with great care
example: The jewelry in the shop was truly exquisite, every detail made by hand.
exampleEs: Las joyas de la tienda eran realmente exquisitas, con cada detalle hecho a mano.
cloze: The jewelry in the shop was truly ____, every detail made by hand.
note: Trap: Spanish 'exquisito' mostly means delicious; English exquisite stresses beauty and fine quality.

definition: relaxed and not formal
example: We have a casual dress code on Fridays.
exampleEs: Los viernes tenemos un código de vestimenta informal.
cloze: We have a ____ dress code on Fridays.
note: Trap: Spanish 'casual' means by chance; for that, use accidental or by coincidence.

es: ebrio, bajo los efectos del alcohol
definition: affected by alcohol or drugs
example: The driver was intoxicated and could not walk straight.
exampleEs: El conductor estaba ebrio y no podía caminar derecho.
cloze: The driver was ____ and could not walk straight.
note: Trap: Spanish 'intoxicado' means poisoned (food poisoning); English intoxicated means drunk.

definition: a phrase whose meaning is different from its separate words
example: 'Break the ice' is a common idiom, not a literal instruction.
exampleEs: 'Romper el hielo' es un modismo común, no una instrucción literal.
cloze: 'Break the ice' is a common ____, not a literal instruction.
note: Trap: 'idioma' means language; idiom means a fixed expression like 'break the ice'.

definition: a message that tries to sell a product or service
example: I saw a funny advertisement for that app on YouTube.
exampleEs: Vi un anuncio gracioso de esa app en YouTube.
cloze: I saw a funny ____ for that app on YouTube.
note: Trap: 'advertencia' means warning; advertisement means an ad. Short form: ad.

definition: very strange and hard to explain
example: The ending of the show was completely bizarre.
exampleEs: El final de la serie fue completamente extraño.
cloze: The ending of the show was completely ____.
note: Trap: Spanish 'bizarro' means brave or gallant; English bizarre means 'raro'.

definition: a thousand million (1,000,000,000)
example: The company is now worth over two billion dollars.
exampleEs: La empresa ahora vale más de dos mil millones de dólares.
cloze: The company is now worth over two ____ dollars.
note: Trap: Spanish 'billón' is a million million, which is a trillion in English.

definition: to think something is true without checking it
example: Don't assume everyone has read the document.
exampleEs: No des por hecho que todos leyeron el documento.
cloze: Don't ____ everyone has read the document.
note: Trap: 'asumir' often means to accept or take on; for 'suponer', English uses assume.

definition: a list of topics to discuss in a meeting
example: Please send the agenda before the meeting starts.
exampleEs: Por favor envía el orden del día antes de que empiece la reunión.
cloze: Please send the ____ before the meeting starts.
note: Trap: Spanish 'agenda' is a planner or diary; English agenda is the list of topics for a meeting.

definition: impressive in a way that makes people respect or fear it
example: She is a formidable negotiator, so prepare carefully.
exampleEs: Es una negociadora temible, así que prepárate con cuidado.
cloze: She is a ____ negotiator, so prepare carefully.
note: Trap: Spanish 'formidable' means great or awesome; English formidable suggests something hard or intimidating.
